title: More Than 50 Employers at Laredo's Hiring Red, White & You Fair Thursday
excerpt: More than 50 employers will be at Laredo's 15th annual Hiring Red, White & You fair on Thursday, Nov. 19, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Falcon Bank Event Center, 7718 McPherson Road.
content:
More than 50 employers will attend a hiring fair in Laredo on Thursday, Nov. 19, aimed at connecting veterans, transitioning service members and their families with jobs, according to KGNS.

The 15th annual Hiring Red, White & You fair runs from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Falcon Bank Event Center, 7718 McPherson Road, Building D, according to Workforce Solutions South Texas. Doors open to the general public at 10 a.m.

The statewide fair is organized with the Texas Workforce Commission, Workforce Solutions, the Texas Medical Center and the Texas Veterans Commission, according to the organizers. It connects transitioning service members, military spouses, National Guard members, reservists, veterans and their families with employers, at no cost to employers.

Employers listed for the Laredo fair include the City of Laredo, Concentrix, Doctors Hospital of Laredo, Laredo College, the Laredo Police Department, Laredo ISD, the Army, the National Guard, the Texas Department of Criminal Justice, 7-Eleven, BIOMAT USA and Pump N Shop, according to Workforce Solutions South Texas.

Job seekers can find more information by calling Workforce Solutions South Texas at 956-794-6500.

Sources: Workforce Solutions South Texas; Texas Workforce Commission; KGNS, Nov. 10, 2026.
